From Metallica · Price: fails on creatures without blood (constructs, most undead).

Theme Affliction

  • 1: 1 action: pull iron from a creature's blood within 30 ft as razors: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[slashing]] (@Check[fortitude|against:stand|basic]{basic Fortitude}); on a critical failure it also takes 1d6 persistent bleed.
  • 5: On a failure, also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 1} from blood loss.
  • 9: Surge: @Damage[(2*ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[slashing]], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{sickened 2} on a failure.
  • 13: Iron camouflage: you can Hide against metal or stone walls without cover, with +2 circumstance to Stealth. A creature that fails Iron Blood's save is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{clumsy 1} for 1 round.
  • 17: Target that critically fails is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{drained 2}.

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.ct7riRsO6HtVVYzs]{Effect: Iron Camouflage}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
